column3: his forearms glow bright red like an anatomy chart showing the muscles burning, his fingers are starting to open and slip off the bar, sweat drops, pained gritted teeth.
he hangs calm and relaxed with his eyes closed and a peaceful content smile, shoulders relaxed, a soft light blue glow along his spine from neck to hips.
a simple wooden chair stands under him and he rests the tips of both feet on the chair seat behind him to take some weight off, calm face.
he holds his lower back with one hand, slightly bent, wincing in pain, a small red glow on his lower back.
he easily twists open a big glass pickle jar with one hand, the lid popping off, confident grin, his forearm muscles are visibly big and veiny.
he carries four heavy full grocery bags, two in each hand, arms straight down, relaxed easy smile, big veiny forearms.
